text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa... ngh.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(...—It's not returning. My strength won't surge.
No, what hasn't returned even more than my strength is...)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(—My feelings.
Even past summer, they've remained completely... completely calm and still.)

The final day of summer camp.
I made a proposal to her.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Is that... because
I haven't gotten back to top form after all?

I show her the tablet in my hand.
The numbers displayed remain unchanged.
Just as she said, summer came to an end without her ever reaching the "top condition" she wanted to regain.
While there are no visible signs of physical ailment—
For a moment, something felt off.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"*pant, pant*!
...Now, accelerate from here—!"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Pheww...gh!
"...When she challenged the Japan Cup last year, she didn't seem satisfied with herself in the slightest."

A fiery resolve to seize it, even if it meant pushing
past her limits by just one more step. That was solely
for the sake of her pure, unblemished determination.
For some reason, that—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *phew*...
—Did I meet the target time?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Thank goodness.
...The breeze... looks like it feels nice.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Well then, I'm off for the last rep.

For some reason,
it feels as if it vanished.
That was the feeling I got.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...
I was thinking the same thing, given my current condition.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Even after you went out of your way to suggest an overseas campaign again...

"No," I hurriedly shook my head.
There were moments when something felt off, but...
She was also trying her hardest to get back on track.
choice_data_list: Anyway, let's do our best in the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.text: Surely—it's just my imagination.

There's no way that the strong resolve
Victoire Pisa held—to weave hope together—
could ever completely vanish.

Above all, her everyday demeanor hasn't changed at all.
She's kind to everyone,
and still refuses to leave anyone on their own.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...You're right.
At any rate, on to the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
If only I could run a race there...
that weaves hope once again.

The end of her sentence wavered in confusion,
leaving it inaudible.

Move forward.
Do that, and surely everything will turn out fine.
